200.description: One page of the containers in the bin (possibly none), ordered by LPN.

schema.description: One keyset page of containers (REST guideline section 3.3), ordered by LPN.

items.description: A sealed case with an identity (ADR 0045). The ledger stays in eaches: `qtyEaches` is the case's content, held by the 1:1 SEALED_CASE stock unit `stockUnitId` once stowed.

lpn.description: License plate - the carton SSCC, or an internal `LPN-<site>-<id>`.

gtin.description: GTIN-14 of the case pack level, resolved in the local PackagingView.

qtyEaches.description: Eaches in the case; always equals `unitsPerPack` for a sealed case.

ownerRef.description: Owner of the case's stock. Omitted for fleet-owned stock.

siteId.description: Site, set by the first stow from the bin's site. Omitted until then.

binId.description: Bin the container is stowed in. Omitted until stowed, and once EMPTY.

expiry.description: Expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the carton declared one.

stockUnitId.description: The SEALED_CASE stock unit holding the eaches, created at the first stow.

receiptId.description: The inbound receipt the case arrived on.

lineNo.description: The receipt line whose booking bounds the container.

items.title: Container

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page, to be passed back unchanged as `cursor`. Absent on the last page.

schema.title: ContainerPage

400.description: `limit` is not an integer between 1 and 500 (invalid-limit), or `cursor` is not a page token this API issued (invalid-cursor).

detail.description: The specific error message for this occurrence.
